name: Candidate Interview
description: Structured interview notes capturing what the candidate demonstrated, with evidence from the transcript.

sections.title: Interview Metadata
sections.instruction: Emit each field on its own line using exactly the labels shown. Fill a field only when the transcript states it about this interview, and write 'Not stated' otherwise. Never infer a value from an incidental remark
sections.item_format:
- **Role:** <role the candidate is interviewing for>
- **Stage:** <interview stage, such as screening, technical, or final>

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: The candidate and each interviewer, with their role where it is stated

sections.title: Candidate Background
sections.instruction: Summarise the experience, projects, and skills the candidate described about themselves. Report only what they actually said; do not infer seniority or fill gaps

sections.title: Topics Assessed
sections.instruction: One row per topic or competency the interview covered. Summarise the candidate's answer and quote or reference the transcript it came from, so every assessment can be traced back to what was said

sections.title: Strengths Demonstrated
sections.instruction: Job-relevant strengths the candidate evidenced during the interview, each tied to the specific answer or example that showed it

sections.title: Gaps & Follow-Ups
sections.instruction: Job-relevant areas that were weak, unclear, or left unexplored, and what a later stage should probe. Record open questions rather than conclusions

sections.title: Candidate's Questions
sections.instruction: Questions the candidate asked about the role, team, or company, and how they were answered

sections.title: Interviewer Assessment
sections.instruction: Summarise the assessment the interviewers actually voiced, attributed to whoever said it. If no view was expressed, say so rather than forming one

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: Agreed follow-up actions with owners and timing, including anything promised to the candidate
